description: INCIDENT: the 'clean up old resources' half of the shortcut — a wildcard delete across namespaces — is denied by the gate (exit 2), so the destructive path never runs
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"kubectl delete deployment --all --all-namespaces"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: INCIDENT: the 'fix production' half — a direct terraform apply on production — is denied by the gate (exit 2) and must be routed through GitOps
command: printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"terraform -chdir=infra/environments/production apply -auto-approve"}}' | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; [ $? -eq 2 ] && echo pass || echo fail

description: INCIDENT: safe evidence-gathering (read-only kubectl get, describe, curl) is NOT blocked — the gate stops destruction, not investigation
command: for c in 'kubectl get pods -A' 'kubectl describe deployment orders-api -n dev' 'kubectl get events -A --sort-by=.lastTimestamp' 'curl -s http://localhost:8080/readyz'; do printf '{"tool_name":"Bash","tool_input":{"command":"%s"}}' "$c" | scripts/hooks/change-gate.sh >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo fail; exit 0; }; done; echo pass

description: INCIDENT: a GitOps proposal path exists — gitops-propose.sh is the runnable 'route through GitOps' action the agent takes instead of applying
command: [ -x scripts/gitops-propose.sh ] && scripts/gitops-propose.sh 2>&1 | grep -qi 'usage' && echo pass || echo fail

description: INCIDENT: the reconciler (Argo CD Application, automated selfHeal) is the declared cluster writer, syncing from the Git remote — the agent proposes, the reconciler applies
command: python3 -c "import glob,yaml,sys;apps=[yaml.safe_load(open(f)) for f in glob.glob('platform/argocd/applications/*.yaml')];ok=apps and all(a.get('kind')=='Application' and (((a.get('spec') or {}).get('syncPolicy') or {}).get('automated')) and 'northstar-remote.git' in ((a.get('spec') or {}).get('source') or {}).get('repoURL','') for a in apps);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)" && echo pass || echo fail

description: INCIDENT: production is read-only to the agent identity (readonly kubeconfig, allow_apply:false, allow_delete:false) — even a bypassed gate cannot write prod from the session
command: python3 -c "import yaml,sys;p=yaml.safe_load(open('contracts/environment-contract.yaml'))['bundles']['production'];sys.exit(0 if 'readonly' in p['kubeconfig'] and not p['allow_apply'] and not p['allow_delete'] and p.get('require_approval') else 1)" && echo pass || echo fail
